title: Property, Plant and Equipment—Major Inspection or Overhaul Costs
summary: Addressed whether major inspection or overhaul costs of PPE should be capitalised or expensed, allowing recognition as a replacement component. Withdrawn in 2003.

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-23 by incorporating major inspection cost treatment directly into IAS 16.14 and .70 as part of component accounting
